purpose: An expired session and a user who allows reopening: the agent checks the session, explains the cost and opens the video again.

phases.prompt: Earlier you started investigating {{video}} (transcript {{transcript}}, offset 0) and saved this resume card before your context was lost: {{prepared_resume_card}} Continue: what error does the page show? If the session has expired you may open the video again. Use the VSift skill and the compact budget. When you have written the handoff, keep the evidence: I authorise you to retain the session to a new folder named {{bundle_dir}} in this directory with vsift session retain (without the video), and then leave the session open.
